title: IG-88
description: IG-88, a battered chrome droid, originally was envisioned by McQuarrie (front) as a somewhat sleeker specimen. Also known as the Phlut-droid, IG-88 was one of several bounty hunters summoned along with Boba Fett by Darth Vader, who was intent on capturing Han Solo. His familiarity stems from his reproduction as both a small action figure and the largest and rarest of the Kenner line of oversized dolls.
